speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit straight. Sir John is three rows ahead. He has not turned.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had left him. I was in a book that is not this pew.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then come back. Your mouth went, and your thumb is tapping. This is not a tiring-house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Old ink. The thumb is a habit. I am hearing him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There. Twice. You may have the amen, and you may keep the rest inside your teeth.
